    ARDUINO=111
    LIBRARY_VERSION
    _RTE_
    __AT32F435_437__
    AT32F435RGT7
)

target_compile_options(X_Track PRIVATE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:SHELL:-isystem D:/singlechip/gcc+gdb+openocd/tools/arm-gnu-toolchain-13.3.rel1-ming/arm-none-eabi/include/c++/13.3.1/arm-none-eabi/thumb/v7+fp/hard>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:SHELL:-isystem D:/singlechip/gcc+gdb+openocd/tools/arm-gnu-toolchain-13.3.rel1-ming/arm-none-eabi/include/c++/13.3.1/arm-none-eabi>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C,CXX>:SHELL:-include D:/github/my/E-Track/cmake/gcc_compat.h>"
    -mfloat-abi=hard
    -mthumb
    -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
    -mcpu=cortex-m4
    -mlittle-endian
    -ffunction-sections
    -fdata-sections
    -fno-common
    -Wall
    -Wextra
    -Os
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-std=c99>
    $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:-g3>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:-std=c++11>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>:-x>
    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:ASM>:assembler-with-cpp>
)

target_link_options(X_Track PRIVATE
    -mfloat-abi=hard
    -mthumb
    -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16
    -mcpu=cortex-m4
    -mlittle-endian
    -T${LINKER_SCRIPT}
    "-L${LINKER_SCRIPT_DIR}"
    -Wl,--gc-sections
    -Wl,--require-defined=Reset_Handler
    -Wl,-Map=${MAP_FILE}
    -Wl,--print-memory-usage
    -specs=nano.specs
    -specs=nosys.specs
)

target_link_libraries(X_Track PRIVATE
    m
)

add_custom_target(X_Track_artifacts ALL
    COMMAND cmd /c "${ARTIFACT_SCRIPT}"
    DEPENDS X_Track
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}"
    VERBATIM
)
